jobs.description:
Supports the Relocation Project Management (RPM) team at multiple campuses as needed in  
Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) activities for all new, renovated and swing space projects  
which includes assistance in programming, specification, budget tracking, procurement coordination,  
scheduling with the construction team, installation, and punch list activities. Supports the RPM team in  
move management activities relating to move scope creation, bidding, analysis of bids, budget  
tracking, move coordination and scheduling, onsite move oversight and punch list activities to ensure  
complete functional occupancy of new and renovated buildings.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Support the Furniture/Equipment/Relocation Project Management Services with emphasis in FF&E  
  selection, procurement coordination and purchasing for all such areas as identified by the District to  
  provide college the onsite FF&E and move-in/relocations management services. Responsibilities  
  include strategic oversight of all FF&E procurement, FF&E Installation, Pre-move, Move, and Post move/Close-out phase activities for specified assigned projects. Services shall be provided at the  
  direction of the College Project Director (CPD) and the Manager of Relocation Project Management  
  team.
* Assist with the procurement and purchasing of FF&E using best-value and/or low bid public  
  contracting.
* Support budget and schedule tracking efforts for FF&E and moves, and meet with relevant Project  
  Architects (A/E), Project Managers, and BUGs, to be able to prepare office layouts and work with  
  the occupants to plan furniture and equipment relocation of existing to the move location. Work  
  with vendors and/or movers to assist with filling in equipment and furnishings where there are  
  gaps.
* Coordinate and prepare a list of all new furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist with the timely and successful onsite FF&E installation, punch-list sign-off and transition  
  during swing space, relocation and/or move into new buildings.
* Support the procurement of specialty contractors or Movers for installations, delivery, and/or  
  connections not covered by the FF&E vendors. Create detailed scope of work for Task Orders for  
  Contractors/Movers as necessary.
* Support the RPM in the working with the Project Interior Designer and the BUG user groups to  
  select and prepare a list of all furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist in the onsite unlocking of all areas requiring access by the movers and others during the PreMove, Move, Installation and Post Move/Close-Out Phases and for the re-securing all such areas.
* Assist in the onsite coordination of all furniture and equipment deliveries with PMs, CPDs, Facility  
  Directors, and BUGs if applicable; work closely with Asset Management Team to coordinate all asset  
  tagging and disposition requirements, and Warranty Program Managers and other members of  
  program staff working towards close-out of projects.
* Maintain all FF&E, move management, moving and storage related documents, including proposals,  
  purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices and

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma.
* 1 year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations,  
  Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawings.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Strong written and oral communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to be onsite at multiple colleges.
* Proficiency Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software.
* Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple locations based on assigned schedule.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Four-year Degree in the areas of Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design,

* Procurement, sourcing or asset management experience.
* Public Works experience.
* Knowledge/proficiency in AutoCAD software.
* Certification/Membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, LEED.

jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

jobs.description:
HealthFitness, a Trustmark company, is a proven leader in providing fitness solutions that engage and connect people both on-site and online, to create a strong community of health. Our work focuses on creating meaningful connections with each of our participants to help them move forward. We foster each individual’s journey by creating communities of health within the organizations we serve – so that everyone is supported. As an employee of HealthFitness you will enjoy a variety of health and financial benefits and receive competitive pay. We provide personal and professional support, training and development and flexible employment opportunities.

**About the role**

Bring your energy to a role where you can shape meaningful experiences every day. HealthFitness is hiring a **Fitness Program Coordinator** in **Torrance, CA**.

What you'll do:

**Create and launch engaging wellness programs** that motivate participants and elevate overall health and fitness outcomes.

**Plan, coordinate, market, and execute events and initiatives** designed to maximize participation and member engagement.

**Lead and support dynamic teams**, ensuring staff are trained, empowered, and equipped to deliver exceptional experiences.

**Monitor program quality and measure success** by tracking participation, outcomes, and overall program effectiveness.

️ **Bring wellness to life** through hands-on delivery, including group exercise instruction, personal training, fitness assessments, exercise prescriptions, and new member orientations.

**Champion a best-in-class fitness environment** by providing facility oversight, supporting daily operations, and creating positive member experiences.

**Schedule**  
Monday–Friday  
✅ No weekends!

**Perks & Benefits**  
Comprehensive benefits package  
Free continuing education credits  
PTO + paid holidays + volunteer paid time off

Responsible for the development, planning, coordination, marketing and/or implementation of designated health and fitness programs and events, maximizing participation and engagement. Manages program delivery process and teams, ensures all staff are properly trained, monitors quality and reports on program outcomes. May also participate in program delivery and perform other staff responsibilities such as instructing group exercise classes; personal training; conducting fitness tests, exercise prescriptions, and orientations; and fitness floor coverage and facility oversight.

* Oversees all programming within designated areas; develops, coordinates, manages, implements, and evaluates health and fitness programs within specified program areas to maximize participation, outcomes and customer satisfaction and supervision of programs, services, and staff. Ensures staff is properly trained and certified.
* Facilitates the close alignment of programs with the client’s business needs, employee culture and corporate health strategies. Coordinates marketing of programs to maximize outreach and engagement; develops and distributes electronic and print promotional materials to communicate program offerings and special events.
* Gathers program outcomes data and measures results; evaluates and reports on program effectiveness in meeting objectives and makes recommendations for future program enhancements or modifications.
* Researches health & fitness educational topics within their specified areas and identifies appropriate participant educational materials.
* Participates in business planning and budgeting process relating to program and service offerings in their area of expertise.
* Provides individual and group exercise instruction as applicable; educates participants on proper techniques to maximize exercise safety and effectiveness.
* Other duties as needed/assigned.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Associates Degree or higher in Exercise Science, Health Promotion, Kinesiology or related discipline and 1+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and experience.
* Current Adult CPR/AED/First Aid certifications from American Heart Association, American Red Cross, National Safety Institute, or American Safety & Health Institute required by start date. (**Note:** certification must have an in-person component and not 100% online/OSHA compliant).
* Demonstrated experience in leading, coordinating and delivering effective programs including budgeting, marketing, and promotions.
* Ability to effectively organize and prioritize work demands.
* Strong interpersonal communication and customer service skills including the ability to motivate others.
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office programs including at minimum Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team with enthusiasm, initiative, and creativity.
* Proficiency in fitness assessment and exercise prescription if applicable.

**Preferred:**

* Industry recognized Group Exercise certification from ACE, AFAA/NASM, ACSM, NCCPT or NETA. (if not current must obtain within 60 days of hire)
* NCCA Accredited Personal Trainer certification from an Industry recognized and HealthFitness approved agency. (if not current must obtain within 90 days of hire)

jobs.title: Production Coordinator (Fashion)
jobs.description:
**Production Coordinator (Fashion)**  
Santa Monica, CA (Onsite, 5 Days a Week)

At SYRN, we’re building more than a brand. We’re creating worlds women can step into. Rooted in self-expression, confidence, and intentional design, SYRN blends elevated craftsmanship with culturally resonant storytelling to create pieces that feel both aspirational and deeply personal.

**Job Description**

We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-driven Production Coordinator to help bring SYRN’s creative vision to life across e-commerce and campaign production. Reporting to the Creative Production Manager, you’ll keep projects moving from pre-production through final delivery, partnering with Operations, Product Development, Design, and Marketing, as well as the best-in-class production teams we collaborate with.

This role will sit at the intersection of project management and creative execution, ensuring every shoot is well planned, well run, and delivered to the highest standard. The ideal candidate brings a production background, takes ownership with confidence, stays composed in a dynamic environment, and has a refined eye for detail and aesthetics.

**What You’ll Do**

**Project Management & Timelines**

* Manage production timelines in partnership with Operations and Product Development, identifying and resolving schedule risks early
* Maintain clear visibility across active projects, deliverables, and deadlines for internal stakeholders and external partners
* Coordinate with Design and Marketing to align on product imagery, approvals, and asset needs
* Keep project trackers, shared drives, and production documentation organized and up to date

**Sample Management**

* Lead sample intake for e-commerce shoots, including purchase order creation with Operations
* Receive, log, and organize samples with precision, reconciling deliveries against style lists
* Manage sample distribution across marketing teams, as well as returns and courier logistics
* Partner cross-functionally to secure product on time for every shoot

**Shoot Production**

* Develop shot lists, style lists, and shoot documentation, and ensure all teams are fully prepared ahead of shoot day
* Support the development of creative decks and mood boards in partnership with the Creative Production Manager
* Coordinate logistics and schedules with producers, photographers, stylists, and crew
* Provide on-set support, overseeing product organization, shot tracking, and deliverables
* Oversee shoot wrap, including breakdown, product reconciliation, and final checks

**Post-Production**

* Prepare retouching decks with selects, file names, and file numbers for creative review
* Manage feedback rounds and revisions with retouchers and editors through final delivery
* Review final assets for accuracy, completeness, and brand standards, and maintain an organized archive

**What You’ll Bring**

* 2–3 years of experience in production, creative production, or production assistant roles, ideally within fashion, apparel, e-commerce, editorial, or agency environments
* Proven on-set experience across photo or video production, from pre-production through delivery
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a strong sense of ownership
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships across teams
* A refined eye for aesthetics and image quality
* Composed, thoughtful, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable working within the intimates category, including on-set production with talent
* Able to work onsite five days a week, with flexibility on shoot days and occasional local travel to set locations

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator, TikTok & Video
jobs.description:
At cabi, we're redefining what it means to build a fashion brand—one rooted in connection, confidence, and purpose. As a women's retail clothing company, we don't just design beautiful apparel; we create opportunities for women to express themselves, build community, and thrive both personally and professionally. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and deeply people-first, and every team member plays a role in creating meaningful experiences for our Stylists and clients. If you're energized by creativity, inspired by empowering others, and excited to contribute to a brand that blends style with substance, you'll feel right at home here.

We are looking for a Social Media Coordinator to own cabi's TikTok presence end to end: concepting, shooting, editing, posting and engaging. You'll know what's trending this week, translate it into cabi's voice, and turn our collections, Stylists and clients into video people want to watch and share. Approximately 90% of the content you capture will go toward TikTok, with the other 10% going to other platforms.

This role is a great fit for a hands-on creator who is comfortable in front of and behind the camera. You'll partner closely with the marketing, design and Stylist-community teams, and edit video for Instagram and other cabi social channels.

We also use AI tools every day to work faster and smarter, from ideation to editing, and we're looking for someone excited to do the same.

**What You'll Do**

**Content creation and video production**

* Dedicate about 90% of captured content to TikTok, with the other 10% going to Instagram and other emerging social platforms.

* Publish content on TikTok daily, concepting, scripting, shooting and editing original videos alongside creator content and carousels: try-ons, styling tips, "one piece, five ways" capsule looks, behind-the-scenes, in-office content, TikTok trends and founder, CEO, or Stylist features.
* Shoot on phone and in studio, handling lighting, framing, audio and on-screen text so every video looks native to TikTok.
* Edit quickly in CapCut, TikTok's in-app editor, Adobe Premiere or similar, with sharp hooks in the first 2 seconds.
* Appear on camera when needed and direct talent, employees, Stylists and creators on set.

* Plan and coordinate content shoots, including shot lists, scheduling, talent, wardrobe and props.
* Attend cabi photo shoots, collection launches, Stylist events and conferences to capture behind-the-scenes and live content.

**Curation and community**

* Find, vet and repost content from cabi Stylists, clients and creators, with proper permissions and credit.
* Run Stitches, Duets and comment-reply videos to keep conversations going.
* Manage TikTok comments, DMs and mentions daily in cabi's voice, flagging customer-service issues to the right team.
* Partner with the Stylist-community team to give Stylists shareable content and simple TikTok how-tos.

**Planning and trends**

* Own the TikTok content calendar, tied to collection launches, seasonal drops and promotions.
* Track trending sounds, formats and fashion conversations daily and pitch timely ideas fast.
* Support TikTok LIVE sessions, influencer and creator partnerships, and TikTok Shop content as those programs grow.

* Partner with the paid social team to supply and adapt organic TikToks for Spark Ads and paid campaigns.

**Reporting**

* Track views, watch time, completion rate, shares, saves, follower growth and traffic to cabionline.com.
* Share a weekly performance recap and use the data to decide what to make more of.
* Repurpose winning TikToks for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.

**Cross-channel support (10%)**

* Repurpose top TikToks and edit video for Instagram and other platforms.
* Source trend and creative inspiration for the broader social calendar.
* Contribute TikTok and video data to bi-weekly and monthly social reports.

Other duties may be assigned.

  

**What You Bring**

* 2–4 years creating short-form video for a brand, ideally fashion, apparel, beauty or lifestyle.
* A portfolio of TikTok videos you concepted, shot and edited, with results you can speak to.
* Fluency in TikTok culture: trends, sounds, formats, the algorithm and what makes people stop scrolling.
* Strong editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar, plus comfort shooting ona phone.

* Working knowledge of Instagram Reels and how short-form content translates across platforms.

* Experience with TikTok analytics and a habit of letting data shape the next video.
* Comfort on camera and confidence directing others.
* Clear writing for captions, on-screen text and comment replies.
* Organized, fast and calm with many deadlines; able to turn a trend around in 24 hours.

* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and recaps.
* Comfort working with minimal supervision in a fast-moving environment, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves wherever needed.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with TikTok Shop, TikTok LIVE or Spark Ads.
* Experience working with creators, influencers or a community of brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with scheduling and listening tools such as Later, Sprout Social or Dash Hudson.
* Photography skills and basic design in Canva or Adobe.
* An eye for styling and a love of women's fashion.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, film or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Regular use of AI tools for ideation, scripting or editing, and curiosity about how AI can change content creation.
* Experience in retail, fashion or direct sales.
* Experience coordinating video or photo shoots.

**What We Offer**

At cabi, we believe our people should be recognized for the impact they make. Our compensation philosophy provides fair, competitive pay based on the value and scope of each role, relevant experience and skills, and the market where the role is based.

* Hourly rate of pay $25 - $35. Total compensation may vary based on relevant exp

ABOUT ELITE HOME STAGING

Elite Home Staging is one of Southern California's leading home-staging companies, specializing in beautifully designed staging for luxury properties. We work closely with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and homeowners to help properties make a powerful first impression and sell successfully.

Our company has built a strong reputation in the Southern California real estate community, and we are continuing to expand our reach.

We are seeking an experienced **Outside Sales Representative / Business Development professional** whose primary responsibility is to generate new business and grow Elite Home Staging's client base.

This is an active, field-based sales position. You will spend your time prospecting, visiting real estate offices, meeting agents, networking, developing relationships, following up with prospects, and closing new staging accounts.

You will have the opportunity to work directly with top-producing real estate agents, luxury brokers, developers, builders, and other industry professionals throughout Southern California.

**This is not an inside sales or desk job. We need someone who enjoys being out in the field, meeting people, creating opportunities, and bringing in business.**

* Generate new business through cold calling, prospecting, networking, office visits, referrals, and in-person meetings.

**PREFERRED:**

* Experience selling to real estate agents, brokers, builders, or developers.

COMPENSATION & EARNING POTENTIAL

Bogart Construction is a licensed commercial general contractor with more than 30 years of experience delivering tenant improvements and ground-up projects nationwide. Our portfolio includes grocery, retail, restaurant, automotive, entertainment, and more. We are known for strong client partnerships, innovative solutions, and an unwavering commitment to safety and quality.

At Bogart Construction, our greatest asset is our people. We place a high value on investing not only in the growth of our company but also in the development and success of our team.

**Job Description**

The **Assistant Project Manager** (APM) supports the Project Manager in the planning, execution, and successful completion of commercial construction projects. This position will primarily support retail renovation, expansion, and ground-up projects, while developing the skills necessary to independently manage projects. The APM is responsible for project documentation, subcontractor administration, procurement tracking, compliance management, change order support, scheduling assistance, and coordination with field operations. The APM may be assigned to manage smaller projects up to approximately $3,000,000 in contract value under the direction of the Project Manager and Project Executive.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist the Project Manager with all phases of project execution from preconstruction through closeout.
* Manage assigned projects up to approximately $3,000,000 in contract value as directed.
* Obtain, submit, track, and distribute project submittals and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Maintain project documentation including procurement logs, submittal logs, RFI logs, change order logs, drawing logs, meeting minutes, schedules, and closeout documents.
* Review drawing revisions, CCDs, SKs, and owner directives and identify potential cost and schedule impacts.
* Assist with subcontractor buyout, bid solicitation, contract administration, and procurement activities.
* Create the SWPPP book and apply for state and local SWPPP permits/NOIs for the project.
* Draft and issue letters of intent, purchase orders, and subcontracts as directed.
* Track subcontractor compliance requirements including insurance, contracts, labor compliance, and project-specific documentation.
* Assist with project cost tracking, change order preparation, owner pay applications, and subcontractor pay application review.
* Assist with schedule updates, procurement tracking, and identification of schedule risks.
* Coordinate owner-furnished and contractor-furnished material deliveries with field staff.
* Attend project meetings, subcontractor meetings, preconstruction meetings, and site visits as required.
* Create and distribute meeting minutes, weekly reports, and client-required project reporting.
* Support client compliance requirements including worker verification, labor documentation, audit preparation, project reporting, etc.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Family Justice Center (the “Center”) is a warm and welcoming one-stop center for victims of interpersonal violence (IPV) -- domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, elder abuse and human trafficking. The Center serves victims and survivors regardless of their income, immigration status or location. The Center is a public-private partnership committed to creating a vibrant community free of coercion and fear. It supports the West Center located in Richmond, the Central Center in Concord, the East Center in Antioch, the South Center in Danville, and the Solano Center in Fairfield.

**POSITION SUMMARY**:

We are accepting applications for one full-time Program Coordinator. We provide generous fringe benefits, including paid holidays, paid annual and sick leave, health insurance coverage, dental and vision coverages, life insurance and retirement

benefits.

Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and supporting the organization's long term safety programs for youth and adults.

· Coordinate special projects (festivals, community listening sessions, workshops, informational meetings).

· Data input, reporting and documentation.

· Facilitation, planning and preparation of monthly community group gatherings, program cohorts, volunteers/interns, multidisciplinary team meetings that include clinicians, psychiatrists, navigators and partners.

· Supporting Site Director with end-to-end program and event coordination.

· Intake, scheduling, and follow up of program clients needed.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

· Review program goals and activities to meet program goals.

· Implement program initiatives & activities, oversee grant deliverables, and refine program designs.

· Coordination with partners, making referrals, following up regarding status of referred clients.

· Engage with partners through outreach.

· Document and report on program outcomes using organization databases like JotForm and Empowerdb.

· Perform other duties, function, special projects, and responsibilities as assigned and deemed necessary by the Site and Executive Director.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**:

· Demonstrated Knowledge of or a background in domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, stalking, elder abuse, or human trafficking.

· Excellent oral and written communication skills, including public speaking, attention to detail and proofreading.

· Strong analytical and organizational skills and problem-solving capabilities

· Proven project/program coordinator/management experience and report writing skills.

· Microsoft Word, Excel, Canva, Dropbox, and Google proficiency.

· High comfort with data collection and evaluation through Excel and Google Sheets.

· Ability and willingness to learn in new areas and practices.

· Teamwork and interpersonal flexibility.

· Able to work independently.

· Self-starter and takes initiative.

· Interest in learning and practicing leadership

· Cultural responsiveness and an alignment with our values and commitments to equity and inclusion.

· Fluency in Spanish or Asian languages is preferred.

· Ability to travel.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

· Bachelor’s Degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.

· Minimum of two years’ worth of experience relevant to the position: training, curriculum, development, program design, and implementation, coaching and victim advocacy.

**SPECIAL CONSIDERATION:**

· Ability to create effective social media posts.

· Excellence in website design and graphics.

· Superb writing skills.

· Ability to fix computers and troubleshoot technical issues.

· Interest in or experience with non-violence work.

· Innovative and creative self-starter.

jobs.title: Administrative Operations Coordinator, Associate
jobs.description:
### **Job Description:**

Bring your organizational skills, attention to detail, and interest in data and process improvement to FHLBank San Francisco.

As an Administrative Operations Coordinator supporting Credit and Collateral Risk Management (CCRM), you’ll help the department maintain accurate information, execute operational controls, and coordinate work across business and technology teams. Your responsibilities will combine advanced administrative support with reporting, process documentation, testing, and project coordination.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, keeping complex activities organized, and finding practical ways to improve how work gets done.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Support accurate data and reporting. Maintain departmental databases, business records, and customer profiles. Process membership and counterparty portfolio changes, reconcile information, and prepare recurring operational, credit agreement, control, and regulatory reports.
* Contribute to credit and collateral operations. Gather source data, maintain customer files, compile reporting inputs, and support analysts with risk monitoring, research distribution, and compliance activities.
* Document and improve processes. Maintain procedures, workflows, job aids, reporting tools, and process inventories. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and reduce manual work for process-owner review.
* Support system and operational changes. Help gather and document business requirements, coordinate stakeholder follow-up, and support user acceptance testing by recording results, tracking defects, and coordinating resolution.
* Coordinate departmental business activities. Support vendor requests, purchase requisitions, disbursements, expense tracking, records retention, and business unit onboarding.
* Support leadership and committee operations. Schedule meetings, prepare management and committee materials, coordinate Credit Committee and Credit Review Working Group attendance, track action items, and prepare minutes for review.
* Handle sensitive information with care. Maintain appropriate controls over confidential business records and regulatory materials in accordance with Bank policies and procedures.

**What you’ll bring**

  

* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint or comparable collaboration tools.
* Strong Excel capabilities, including formulas, lookup functions, pivot tables, data validation, charts, and controlled spreadsheet design.
* Ability to compile, validate, reconcile, and analyze information from multiple sources, identify exceptions and trends, and communicate findings accurately.
* Ability to clearly document processes, controls, requirements, test scenarios, and implementation results.
* Working knowledge of data quality, reconciliation, exception management, process improvement, root-cause analysis, user acceptance testing, and change implementation.
* Strong organization, judgment, discretion, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to prepare accurate materials for leadership, committees, auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders.
* Knowledge of records management, confidentiality requirements, and administrative controls.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
* Familiarity with Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Access, or comparable tools is preferred.

**Why FHLBank San Francisco**

Here, your expertise connects to a broader purpose. You’ll collaborate with skilled colleagues in an organization that values individual contributions and supports employees’ professional growth and work and life goals.

Our benefits support employees and their families, including:

  

* Work from anywhere in the U.S. for six weeks annually, including four individually selected weeks and two Bank designated weeks.
* Medical, dental, vision, and mental health support.
* A 401(k) with company match, life insurance, and disability coverage.
* Vacation, sick leave, holidays, wellness, and volunteer days.
* Backup care for children, elders, and pets, plus parental and family leave.
* Annual wellness and technology stipends, a transit subsidy, and pretax commuter benefits.

**Annual base salary:** $85,000–$95,000

The Federal Home Loan Bank of San Francisco is committed to the principles of equal opportunity in employment (e.g., employees, applicants) and in contracting (e.g., suppliers, vendors) regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a parent, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to cultivating a workplace free of unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation, and are dedicated to fostering vibrant communities by serving as a reliable source of liquidity and resources for affordable housing and economic development.

Salary ranges reflect the base salary that the Bank reasonably expects to pay for a given role and is not inclusive of annual incentive award opportunities, retirement benefits or the value of other health and welfare or other ancillary benefits. We consider many factors when determining base salaries such as individual background and experience, the competitive environment, education, particular skill set(s), and industry and institutional knowledge.

The Bank is committed to offering all team members challenging and engaging work with market competitive pay, retirement, and benefit offerings. In support of this commitment, the Bank routinely engages in market competitive benchmarking surveys and analysis to ensure our team members continue to be paid fairly and competitively.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator

RMW architecture & interiors is an innovative, award-winning architecture and interior design firm, with a collaborative culture. Our mission is to design engaging workplaces for great companies. We are currently experiencing exciting growth and seeking a Marketing Coordinator to play a pivotal role in our firm. This is a firmwide position.

**Role:**

The Marketing Coordinator will play a key role in supporting the Marketing Department and business development efforts across all studios. They will be responsible for maintaining the lead’s lifecycle, managing the CRM, and corresponding with potential clients and subcontractors. Additionally, the Marketing Coordinator will work closely with the Marketing Manager to draft marketing materials, award submissions, media packets, and pitches. This position works closely with principals, project teams, and external consultants to develop compelling materials that reflect the quality of our design work and the values of our firm.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist in producing proposals, qualifications packages, brochures, presentations, and other marketing collateral.
* Review RFQs and RFPs, identify compliance requirements, and help ensure complete and timely submissions.
* Participate in pursuit kickoffs, strategy sessions, interview preparation, and post-pursuit debriefs.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
Nimble is hiring an **Enterprise Account Manager** to own retention and revenue growth across a portfolio of enterprise customers.

You will lead the commercial relationship from post-sale handoff through renewal and expansion, building a deep understanding of customers’ technical priorities and translating measurable value into growing partnerships.

This is a hands-on, quota-carrying role that combines strategic account management, enterprise selling, and customer advocacy. You will work closely with technical stakeholders and executive buyers to identify new use cases, expand adoption, and negotiate agreements that support long-term growth.

  
Requirements:
  

* **3+ years in enterprise SaaS Account Management, Sales, or commercially accountable Customer Success roles.**
* A proven record of **meeting or exceeding renewal and expansion quotas**, with direct ownership of commercial outcomes.
* Experience managing **complex enterprise accounts**, including multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and contract negotiations.
* Strong discovery and account planning skills, with the ability to turn customer needs into qualified opportunities and closed revenue.
* Experience working with **technical stakeholders**, such as Data, AI, Engineering, or BI teams, and connecting technical capabilities to business value.
* Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to navigate pricing discussions, handle objections, and negotiate agreements.
* Discipline in pipeline management, CRM hygiene, and revenue forecasting.
* Clear communication and the ability to build credibility with both technical teams and executive buyers.
* Comfort working in a startup environment, balancing portfolio ownership with the opportunity to help build a growing function.

  
Responsibilities:
  

* **Own customer growth, retention, and NRR targets** across your portfolio, with direct accountability for renewals and existing-customer revenue growth.
* **Manage renewal and expansion opportunities from discovery through close**, including qualification, proposals, negotiation, and procurement.
* **Build and execute strategic account plans** that connect customer priorities with new use cases, broader adoption, and revenue opportunities.
* **Develop relationships across each account**, engaging technical users, internal champions, executive sponsors, and economic buyers.
* **Identify and develop expansion opportunities** by understanding customers’ workflows, business objectives, and unmet needs.
* **Lead business reviews** that demonstrate measurable value, align on customer priorities, and establish clear next steps.
* **Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast**, with visibility into renewal timing, expansion potential, commercial risks, and actions needed to close.
* **Identify and address retention risks early**, coordinating with Solutions, Product, and Engineering to resolve barriers to customer value.
* **Partner with Sales on customer handoffs** to establish continuity around commitments, stakeholder relationships, and growth potential.
* **Help build the Account Management motion**, contributing practical account planning templates, renewal processes, and expansion playbooks.

  
About us:  
  

Nimble is the company leading the AI web search category. Our products are used by leading businesses in financial services, retail, market intelligence, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with accurate, auditable programmatic access to the web.

We've raised over $70 million from Norwest, Databricks Ventures, Target Global, Square Peg, and others to build expert-level web search for AI. Hundreds of enterprise customers already run on Nimble, and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, researchers, designers, marketers, sellers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

**Why join Nimble?**

* Work on a deeply technical platform powering real-time AI and enterprise decisions
* Help define the future of Web Search Agents and live web intelligence
* Build alongside a sharp, mission-driven team that moves fast, ships often, and takes ownership

----------------

**Lead clients — and their teams — to greatness.** In this role, you'll work to take our clients' complex problems, break them down into solvable pieces, and match them with Blue State' teams and expertise. You'll serve as a close partner to key clients, instinctively understanding their business challenges and translating them into briefs that inspire our strategy and delivery teams. You'll lead and facilitate smart conversations with a variety of organizations, challenging their thinking to ensure we deliver the best possible outcome. We value new approaches and perspectives and it's our priority to make space for your growth and development. If you want to advance your career by working with clients facing diverse challenges across a variety of industries, this is the place for you.

**The company**
---------------

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From Google and UNICEF to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency and has 150+ employees in the US and London.

**A day in the life**
---------------------

* Coordinate projects across channels including mail, email, SMS, and paid media for multiple client accounts, driving the best strategy and/or execution to meet clients' needs in an agile and responsive way
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and understand project priorities in the context of agency and client expectations
* Lead cross-functional teams to implement client campaigns over online and offline channels, including mail, email, SMS, and others
* Manage the copy, creative, and campaign expense approval process with clients
* Own the production and QA process for direct response communications in a variety of channels, including mail, email, SMS, and others
* Write and present client-facing strategy and creative briefs based on the output of internal and external creative kickoffs

* Have a clear view of Blue State's various offerings and identify opportunities to add value and support clients' needs as they expand or change

**The team**

Our Accounts and Project Management Team is at the heart of everything we do. Our charge is to take complex problems and break them down into solvable pieces. We are close partners with our clients, understanding their needs, worries and hopes and translating that into inspirational charges for our creative, strategy, and technology teams. We are intellectually curious and love to explore the use of new digital platforms and tools. Our energy and our passion for our work is contagious.

The salary for this position is $74,750.

* 3+ years of relevant experience in client services, direct mail marketing, digital marketing, paid media, fundraising or a related area
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, team oriented mindset, attention to detail
* Experience with (or willingness to learn) project management tools and methodologies
* Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you.

jobs.title: GME Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The GME (Graduate Medical Education) Program Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and managing the administrative and operational activities associated with medical education programs at MSKCC.

The individual will support the onboarding, credentialing, documentation, and ongoing administration of residents, fellows, medical students, and visiting observers.

This position requires someone with strong administrative and organizational skills and familiarity with a hospital or healthcare environment.

The coordinator will work closely with GME Administration, HR, internal hospital departments, external institutions, and medical education applicants to ensure that all onboarding and compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.

**In simple terms:** This is a healthcare administrative coordination role focused on managing the onboarding and documentation of medical residents, fellows, students, and observers.

**2. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

### **A. Program Operations & Coordination**

* Review and evaluate approximately 500 observer applications annually.
* Determine applicant eligibility based on established checklists and program requirements.
* Respond to inquiries from prospective applicants regarding application procedures and eligibility.
* Coordinate onboarding for medical students, observers, residents, and fellows.
* Arrange orientation, housing, paperwork, training programs, and access to hospital systems.
* Coordinate with other hospitals, universities, and external institutions for applicant onboarding.
* Ensure all applicants complete the necessary documentation and onboarding formalities.

### **B. Administrative Support**

* Track applicant onboarding progress through the HR Applicant Tracking System.
* Enter and maintain information in the GME credentialing database.
* Prepare registration materials for incoming residents, fellows, medical students, and observers.
* Maintain electronic and physical records, files, correspondence, and documentation.
* Prepare and distribute appointment and reappointment packages.
* Scan, index, and organize affiliation agreements and other institutional documents.
* Monitor the status of institutional affiliation agreements.
* Coordinate logistics for orientations, educational lectures, meetings, and departmental events.
* Manage front-office responsibilities, including phone calls and general inquiries.

### **C. Database & Information Management**

* Maintain databases containing applicant paperwork, credentials, and onboarding information.
* Provide documentation and status updates to the GME Credentials Coordinator.
* Maintain institutional affiliation agreement records.
* Manage and navigate various hospital and administrative systems, including:CONNECTiCIMSAuricoNew InnovationsNYS Health Commerce System
* Manage Health Commerce account activations for approximately 800 house staff members annually.

### **D. Compliance & Documentation**

* Maintain credentialing records in accordance with New York State medical staff standards.
* Ensure observer documentation and policies are followed.
* Support compliance with New York State Department of Health (DOH) and Department of Education (DOE) regulations.
* Ensure all required onboarding and credentialing documentation is complete and properly maintained.
* Handle confidential employee, student, and medical education records appropriately.

\*\*Job title and position title are interchangeable. Titles are based on contractual obligations as designated by funding sources.

**ABOUT UNITED ACTIVITIES UNLIMITED:** Staten Island, NY; United Activities Unlimited, Inc. (UAU) is a community-based agency that provides a wide range of services that is inclusive of job placement, youth development programs and community outreach services to inspire, transform, and empower individuals of all ages. UAU is responsive to the needs of diverse populations and implements programs that support positive outcomes for individuals and communities. The comprehensive nature of UAU's programming options and the emphasis on holistic services for individuals and families make UAU an outstanding resource and a pillar of support for communities. UAU is dedicated to the engagement, education, and empowerment of individuals and strives to transform individuals and communities to create a better future. EOE

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The Program Coordinator – Staten Island Career Ready will oversee UAU’s Staten Island school-based programming within the Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP) and Work, Learn, and Grow (WLG) programs. The Program Coordinator will ensure the delivery of high-quality programming aligned with UAU policies, Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) guidelines, and Department of Education (DOE) requirements. This position will provide oversight, supervision, and strategic guidance to Staten Island Career Ready Youth Employment Coordinators (YECs), supporting program recruitment, enrollment, orientation, worksite placements, participant engagement, payroll, and compliance. The Program Coordinator will also lead project management, staff training, and technical assistance to ensure program effectiveness, compliance, and the achievement of established goals and performance benchmarks.

**PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES (include but are not limited to):**  

* Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with faculty, staff, administrators, and school-based Work-Based Learning teams at Staten Island DOE Career Ready partner schools.
* Serve as the primary liaison between Staten Island Career Ready schools and the UAU Workforce team to support program goals, deliverables, and partnership development.
* Expand UAU’s presence within Staten Island Career Ready schools through participation in school activities, community events, and stakeholder meetings, and oversee the planning and implementation of annual career fairs with partner schools.
* Develop and maintain a centralized database of school contacts, partnership activities, and relevant communications to support coordination across the Workforce team.
* Provide direct supervision, training, and technical assistance to Staten Island YECs, including regular site visits to partner schools, observation of YEC-led workshops, annual performance evaluations, and input on YEC school assignments, ensuring they have the resources, guidance, and support needed to meet program objectives.
* Establish clear staff expectations, performance goals, and deadlines in collaboration with program leadership while promoting accountability and professional development.
* Oversee and support YECs with participant recruitment, enrollment, orientation, and retention for SYEP and WLG programming, including establishing school-level recruitment targets in collaboration with program leadership and reviewing YEC outreach and marketing strategies.
* Monitor enrollment and retention outcomes to ensure contractual targets and DYCD deadlines are met, implementing re-engagement strategies as needed and serving as the escalation point for participant and worksite concerns raised by YECs.
* Lead audit readiness by reviewing and validating YEC peer audits of participant and worksite files and conducting internal reviews to ensure program documentation, participant records, and activities comply with DYCD requirements and UAU policies ahead of DYCD’s formal audit.
* Oversee Project-Based Learning (PBL) and Professional Technical Development (PTD) applications and related participant onboarding, ensuring requirements and deadlines are met.
* Guide YECs in preparing and delivering culminating SYEP presentations that demonstrate program impact and oversee the transition of eligible SYEP participants into WLG.
* Maintain consistent communication with program leadership regarding program progress, staffing needs, challenges, and strategies for continuous improvement.

Are you passionate about helping advertisers unlock the full potential of their marketing strategies? In this role, you will own advertiser relationships, translating complex business challenges into actionable advertising strategies that deliver measurable outcomes. **About Us:** 
**AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

  

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn,Luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

**The Role**
------------

This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You’ll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won’t be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you’ll be a credible partner in those conversations.

The profile we’re hiring is a technical account manager. You’ve worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can work credibly with everyone from a CxO to a Developer.

*What the role is*

* An early seat. You’re helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence this team figures out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you
* A technical customer-facing role. You’ll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they’re building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it’s needed
* A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences

*What the role is not*

* A traditional post-sales role. You’re measured on revenue, not health scores
* An on-call support function. You’re not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You’re growing accounts
* A technical delivery role. You’re not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people
* A fully built motion. Much of this is still being built. If you spot gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook, you help build them
* A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer company team self. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. “this is my job”

**What You’ll Work On:**
------------------------

* Build Modal’s account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business
* Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts
* Grow an account’s first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform
* Get fluent enough in Modal to engage confidently with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product
* Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap
* Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and find expansion opportunities

**You May Be a Fit If:**
------------------------

* You’ve owned a revenue target or supported one in a highly technical, consumption business.
* You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.
* You’re hands on building with AI tools, not just consuming workflows that were built for you.
* You treat your book of business and your projects as your own. You’re highly organized, bringing stability, predictability, and pace to your work, and you’re comfortable taking action without waiting for direction.
* You’d rather start something today than pick it up tomorrow. You move fast, take the learnings, and iterate on them.
* You’re low ego, easy to work with, and highly accountable. You ask for feedback, you act on it, and you’d rather be corrected early than right late. Internal teams love working with you.

If you don’t match every point above but the role sounds like yours, we’d still like to hear from you.

  

**Nice-to-Have:**
-----------------

* Experience as a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or similar type role
* Certification as an engineer (ex. Computer Science Degree, Professional Bootcamps)
* Early GTM hire experience at a fast-growing startup
* You’ve sat close to GPU spend, model training, or inference workloads

Compensation Range: $230K - $350K

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world's biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified's AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

**About the Role**
------------------

At Riskified, we succeed when our merchants succeed. As such, you'll be the merchant's representative within Riskified, helping them to maximize the value they receive from our service. You will be expected to manage and prioritize their needs to ensure they're happy and profitable. Your clients will include Fortune 500 companies, big-box retailers, startups, travel merchants, and more. You'll collaborate daily with various Riskified teams, including Product, Analytics, Data Science and Development.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Own a portfolio of merchants as their primary point of contact, from onboarding through renewal and expansion
* Monitor portfolio health at scale (approval rates, chargeback rates, SLA performance and order volume) using dashboards and AI tools, and act on risks and opportunities before merchants raise them
* Build and run AI-powered workflows for account research, business review prep, follow-ups and routine merchant questions, then share what works so the whole team benefits
* Design repeatable, one-to-many programs, such as automated health check-ins, templated business reviews, webinars and lifecycle campaigns, so every merchant gets consistent value
* Decide which tasks should be automated and which deserve a person's time, and go deeper with the merchants who have the most growth potential or risk
* Use usage and performance data to prioritize your book, and identify and lead upsell and cross-sell opportunities
* Onboard new merchants quickly through a standardized, scalable process
* Work with Product, Analytics, Data Science and Development to turn patterns across your portfolio into product feedback and process improvements

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 2–4+ years of experience in a client-facing role such as account management or customer success, ideally managing a large portfolio of mid-market or SMB customers
* You use AI tools in your daily work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back
* Hands-on experience building automations (CRM workflows, no-code tools, scripts or AI agents); SQL is a plus
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify salient data from multiple sources and use it to prioritize a large book
* Ability to interpret and present complex data clearly and concisely
* Superb writing and communication skills
* Highly organized and structured, and comfortable managing many accounts at once in a fast-paced environment
* Problem-solver, resourceful and independent; you'd see automating part of your own role as a win
* Great interpersonal skills and a team player
* eCommerce/FinTech background and/or experience working in a fast-growth B2B SaaS setting is strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree - preferably in a highly quantitative field

  

This is an incentive-based role and a significant portion of compensation is based on performance against objectives. The OTE range for this position is $187,000- 204,000. This range is applicable to candidates who will perform the job either wholly, or in part, within New York City. Actual salary will be based on qualifications, competencies, and location. If you feel this range is not attractive, we encourage you to let us know through the application process.

Base salary is just one part of the pay package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees. We invite you to apply at www.riskified.com to learn more about what we have to offer.

  

**Life at Riskified**
---------------------

We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking. We're looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.

Some of our NYC Benefits & Perks:

* Our NYC team is currently working in a hybrid of remote and in-office for all our team members
* Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance from your first day
* Equity for all employees, 401(k) + matching, commuter benefits
* Catered lunch, fully-stocked kitchen, team events, happy hours, birthday celebrations
* Yoga, pilates, soccer league, wellness classes
* Wide-ranging opportunities to volunteer and make an impact in local communities
* Commitment to your professional development with global onboarding, sales bootcamp, skills-based courses, full access to Udemy, lunch & learns
* Awesome Riskified gifts and swag!

  

**In the News**
---------------

Reuters: General Atlantic-backed Riskified valued at $4.3 bln in NYSE debut

Fortune Magazine: Riskified named Best Workplaces in New York for 2022

The Muse: Q&A with Sales

jobs.title: Research Coordinator - Spinal Cord Injury Model Systems project
jobs.description:
**About Shepherd Center**

With five decades of experience, Shepherd Center provides world-class clinical care, research, and family support for people experiencing the most complex conditions, including spinal cord and brain injuries, multi-trauma, traumatic amputations, stroke, multiple sclerosis, and pain. An elite center ranked by *U.S. News* as one of the nation’s top hospitals for rehabilitation, Shepherd Center is also recognized as both Spinal Cord Injury and Traumatic Brain Injury Model Systems. Shepherd is the only rehabilitation facility in the nation with an intensive care unit on-site, allowing us to care for the most complex patients and begin the rehabilitation process sooner. Shepherd Center treats thousands of patients annually with unmatched expertise and unwavering compassion to help them begin again.

Shepherd Center's culture is one of hope, humor, and hard work. You will enjoy career growth, strong relationships with co-workers, strong support from leadership, and fun activities that have kept over 12% of staff members working at Shepherd for more than 20 years.

Located in Atlanta, GA, this is a local, grant funded position.
  
Travel within the Atlanta Metro area is required.
  
The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) is a research professional that facilitates and coordinates research studies. The CRC works alongside the principal investigator to ensure participant safety and study quality. The CRC is specifically responsible for participant recruitment, participant screening, study implementation, data collection and data management.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The clinical research coordinator performs a wide range of professional, administrative, and evaluation responsibilities. The research coordinator will:

* Collaborate with the principal investigator and research/clinical teams to implement research studies.
* Develop high level of familiarity with the protocol, e.g., study proceedings and timelines, inclusion and exclusion criteria, confidentiality, privacy protections, etc.
* Implement recruitment strategies in accordance with IRB requirements and approvals.
* Perform participant screening activities to ensure participant eligibility per inclusion/exclusion criteria and investigator oversight.
* Perform consent discussions with eligible participants as part of the consenting process.
* Obtain informed consent from participant or Legally Authorized Representative alone and/or with the investigator.
* Perform assessments as qualified by training and experience such as vital signs, vision screening, sample collection, ECGs, etc.
* Administer surveys and questionnaires and perform standardized assessments.
* Perform source audits and meet with investigator regularly to resolve data queries and concerns.
* Transcribe data into the study data capture system.
* Manage data capture and data transfer.
* Schedule study visits, and coordinate staff, resources and ancillary services, as required.
* Provide education to participants and caregivers.
* Prioritize participant safety by reporting outcomes and adverse events to the investigator/sponsor in a timely fashion.
* Regularly report participant statuses to the investigator throughout research engagement.
* Review participant medical records and charts, as required.
* Generate and distribute resource materials for participants, caregivers, and staff.
* Develop systems, forms, and documents to efficiently collect data and implement studies.
* Collaborate with pharmacists for the dispensing and storage of investigational products (IP).
* Ensure best practices are followed in the management of IP for drug, device, and biologic studies.
* Collect, record, and prepare data for transmission to sponsor and/or publication.
* Prepare for and attend investigator meetings, sponsor monitoring sessions, site audits, and inspections. Ensure follow up actions are resolved.
* Communicate with Institutional Review Board(s) and manage submissions.
* Maintain regulatory documents for assigned studies.
* Develop working relationships with study sponsors, collaborating medical centers, and academic institutions.
* Maintain accurate time records for work performed on research studies.
* Order and track study supply inventories.
* Manage participant reimbursements and stipends.

*Other requirements:*

* Practices proper safety techniques in accordance with Shepherd Center and departmental policies and procedures. Responsible for the reporting of employee/patient/visitor injuries or accidents, or other safety issues to the supervisor and in the occurrence notification system.
* Monitors and ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements, organizational standards, and policies and procedures related to area of responsibility. Identifies potential risk areas within area of responsibility and supports problem resolution process.

**REQUIRED MINIMUM EDUCATION**

* Level I: Bachelor of Science in related field.
* Level II: Advanced Degree such as master’s in public health (MPH)
* Level III: Advanced Degree

**REQUIRED MINIMUM CERTIFICATION**

* Basic Life Support Certification (BLS)

**REQUIRED MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

* Level I: Minimum of two (2) years clinical research experience required.
* Level II: Three (3) years clinical research experience and advanced degree.
* Level III: Five (5) years, advanced degree, and specialty certification(s).

**REQUIRED MINIMUM SKILLS**

* Completes orientation and initial assessment of competency successfully by determined due date.
* Completes mandatory education and annual competency assessment requirements by determined due date.
* Computer Competency including proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with data storage and analysis systems helpful.
* Superior written communication skills.
* Flexibility to work shift per protocol demands.
* Basic testing competency (i.e. vital signs, collecting urine/blood specimens, specimen processing and shipping, ECG, etc.) per center

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

Swift Straw is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Customer Success Manager to join our team in our Atlanta, GA office. The Customer Success Manager will receive, process, and coordinate day to day orders for Swift Straw’s Wholesale and Manufacturing customers, support the Director of Customer Success in sales initiatives, foster customer relationship development, and serve as a dependable point of contact for our pine and wheat straw products in rolls, bales, and bags. This role includes managing customer orders across both divisions, identifying and closing new opportunities, and coordinating with the fulfillment team in Jasper and the wholesale logistics team so that every load is delivered when the customer needs it. Reporting directly to and working alongside the Director of Customer Success, the Customer Success Manager will share a book of customers with them, jointly manage those relationships, and handle the administrative tasks associated with the sales function.

**Responsibilities**

**Sales Order Management and Customer Relations**

* Accurately enter, track, and prioritize customer orders for both the Wholesale and Manufacturing divisions to ensure timely and efficient fulfillment.
* Ensure all customer orders and related information are promptly entered into company systems with full accuracy, maintaining up-to-date records for seamless order processing.
* Verify the accuracy of order details, pricing, payment terms, and ship to addresses in the system to prevent errors and ensure a smooth fulfillment process.
* Record customer credits in the system as soon as they are requested, before the resolution is worked, so that no credit request goes unlogged.
* Manage backorders, order changes, and split shipments, communicating revised timelines to customers before they have to ask.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of our pine and wheat straw products across rolls, bales, and bags to provide knowledgeable support and effectively address customer questions and feedback.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, addressing questions and providing updates on order statuses, shipping timelines, and product information.
* Handle customer complaints professionally and efficiently, working towards effective solutions that enhance customer satisfaction.

  

**Fulfillment and Logistics Coordination**

* Work daily with the Manufacturing fulfillment team in Jasper to confirm bagged product availability, production timing, and load readiness.
* Coordinate with the Wholesale logistics team to schedule freight, sequence loads, and confirm delivery dates against customer requirements.
* Communicate accurate ETAs to customers and reset expectations clearly and early when timelines shift.
* Serve as the connection point between the customer, fulfillment, and logistics so that each load gets delivered when it is needed.
* Escalate supply, capacity, or delivery constraints to the Director of Customer Success early enough that the customer can still be given options.
* Work open credits through to resolution with the supply and logistics teams, following up until each one is closed out and keeping the customer informed along the way.

  

**Relationship Management and Opportunity Development**

* Share a book of customers with the Director of Customer Success, serving as the inside point of contact and partnering with them to manage and grow each relationship.
* Conduct regular outreach to strengthen customer relationships, identify evolving needs, and maintain customer loyalty.
* Use the CRM function in Salesforce to track opportunities through the pipeline, log activity, and drive opportunities to close.
* Identify and qualify new leads to expand Swift Straw’s customer base across distributors, yards, and retail accounts.
* Collaborate with the Director of Customer Success to nurture high-potential leads, developing tailored approaches and strategies to convert them into loyal customers.
* Maintain and update customer, contact, and ship to information in Salesforce and support other sales-related tools and systems.
* Prepare and share regular reporting on order activity, open opportunities, and account trends with the Director of Customer Success and the Director of Sales.

  

**Qualifications and Characteristics**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Marketing, or a related field.
* Previous experience in an inside sales, customer service, or order management role preferred, ideally within manufacturing, agriculture, building products, or a similar industry.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook) and a willingness to learn and utilize Salesforce CRM and our manufacturing order system.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly, concisely, and in a personable manner over the phone and in writing.
* Highly organized with attention to detail and a solution-oriented approach.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and capacity to handle challenging conversations professionally and effectively.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and manage changing priorities in a fast-paced, seasonal environment.
* Comfort working across two divisions with different products, customers, and fulfillment processes.
* Willingness and ability to travel periodically or on a limited basis to visit key customers alongside the Director of Customer Success.

  

**Position Impact**

* This position will work in a supportive and collaborative environment with an energetic, positive, and results-driven team.
* This position directly impacts customer satisfaction by delivering a superior customer experience and playing a key role in customer retention and growth.
* This position multiplies the reach of the Director of Customer Success by owning the inside work, freeing them to spend more time in front of customers.
